title: Refuse a branch whose agent holds two live claims, server-side
goal: One task at a time is enforced client-side by claim (atomic refs/claim-agents/<AGENT> plus the live-claim scan) but a hand-pushed refs/claims/<id> can give one agent two live claims. CI must refuse the push, counting only non-expired claims so a lapsed claim the agent moved on from is never mistaken for a second one.
